post.description:
Serve data from the database.

Args:
    db_session (DBSessionDep): Database session dependency.
    name_search (str, optional): Name search string. Defaults to "".
    entity_output (Literal["planet", "star", "both"], optional): Entity output type. Defaults to "both".
    serve_params (ServeParams, optional): Parameters for serving data. Defaults to None.
    offset (int, optional): Offset for pagination. Defaults to 0.
    limit (int, optional): Limit for pagination. Defaults to 100.
    sort_by (str, optional): Field to sort by. Defaults to "planet.name".
    sort_dir (str, optional): Sort direction ("asc" or "desc"). Defaults to "asc".
    hide_empty (bool, optional): Whether to hide empty results. Defaults to True.
    version_guid (Optional[str], optional): Measurement version GUID. Defaults to None.
    reference_guid (Optional[str], optional): Reference GUID to filter by. Defaults to None.
    select_all (bool, optional): Whether to select all results ignoring pagination. Defaults to False
    with_reference (bool, optional): Whether to include full reference data in the output. Defaults to True.
    by_reference (bool, optional): Whether to group results by reference. Defaults to False.
